question: What is the use of a jack?

options.text: To lift and support a vehicle during repairs

solution:
The correct answer is __To lift and support a vehicle during repairs****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A jack__ is a mechanical device used to lift heavy loads or apply great forces.
 
• It is commonly used to lift vehicles off the ground for maintenance and repair purposes.
 
• The most common types of jacks include hydraulic jacks and mechanical jacks.
 
• Hydraulic jacks use fluid pressure to lift heavy objects, while mechanical jacks use screw threads.
 
• Jacks are essential tools for automotive repair and are included in most vehicle toolkits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Trolley Jack:**
 
 
• A trolley jack is a portable hydraulic jack mounted on wheels for ease of positioning under a vehicle.
 
• It is commonly used in garages and workshops for vehicle repair.
 
 
 
• **Scissor Jack:**
 
 
• A scissor jack is a compact and lightweight jack that uses a crisscross mechanism to lift a vehicle.
 
• It is typically included as a standard tool with cars for emergency tire changes.
 
 
 
• **Hydraulic Bottle Jack:**
 
 
• A hydraulic bottle jack is shaped like a bottle and uses hydraulic pressure to lift heavy loads.
 
• It is commonly used for lifting trucks and SUVs due to its high lifting capacity.
